_contract: The 'sha256' field is the expected SHA-256 hex digest of the asset named by 'assetName'. Tests that supply their own zip payload compute an actual hash at runtime and write a temporary checksum JSON following this same schema, then pass -TrustedChecksumPath pointing to it. The hash in this fixture matches the content of release-windows-x64.json and serves as a deterministic example — real installations must use checksums published by the release author.
